title: secure-vectors
responsibility: Owns the secure-vectors build or maintenance script.

errors.name: Secure vector directory creation failure
errors.description: An Error whose code property holds the system error code (for example EACCES), thrown by mkdirSync('test/support', { recursive: true }) when that directory cannot be created or by writeFileSync('test/support/secure-vectors.json', ...) when the file cannot be written; both paths are relative to the current working directory. Nothing in the script catches it, so the run stops at the failed call.
